summary.headline: Astrological Elections and Omens
summary.text: Chapters 116–136 of an astrological compendium cover eclipse significations, the Dog Star’s rising, inceptions, travel, marriage, grooming, clothing, purgation, surgery, bloodletting, building, loans, theft, markets, suspected harm, virginity, diseases, and changing conditions, with cross-references to Codex Bononiensis 18 and repeated chapters 206–216.
